name: pr-review
category: Workflow · PR review → findings → PR comment
description: Review a GitHub pull request — or any other code change: an uncommitted working-tree diff, a commit, a branch — and return severity-graded actionable findings that name the exact scenario each issue needs. Reads full files and the PR's stated intent, not just diffs, and when the request says comment / 评论, posts the finished review to the PR as one plain comment via gh.

runtime: git for diff modes; gh authenticated for PR mode
